name: TC-LMC-11: Check Offers lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/LatestModelsByCategory.cy.js#Homepage - LatestModelsByCategory [en] TC-LMC-11: Check Offers lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-LMC-11
**Title:** Check Offers lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits
**Language:** en

**Description:**
On the default 3 Wheelers tab, open Check Offers, fill a valid name, an invalid (5-digit) mobile number, and leave city empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown mobile-format and location-required validation messages are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the default 3 Wheelers tab
2. Open Check Offers on one visible card
3. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
4. Submit with city left empty
5. Verify the mobile-format and location validation messages are shown
